summary: Frontend-only verification of Check-In v2.14 (CR-385) layout restructure. No JS console errors. Structure PASS (LEFT = booking facts + room-section + collapsible ID cards; RIGHT = bill + collection + pinned footer). Room-in-LEFT drives RIGHT live PASS (upgrade Paid ₹6,900 → total ₹2,310 → ₹9,555; checkin-upgrade-charge appears). Collapsible cards & auto-collapse-when-complete PASS. Manual-expanded card stays open PASS. F1 lightbox PASS. F3 pills disabled-at-0 + selected pill WHITE (rgb 255,255,255) PASS (v2.13 250 delta fixed). Card relabel to Txn/UTR + readiness PASS. Confirm-happy-path + MOCKED toast + pane closes PASS. a5 prepaid on-file auto-collapsed 'ID ready' PASS. a1 arrival chip PASS. Mobile 390 stacks / no h-overflow PASS. Checkout bill=107 ₹0 + bill=103 ₹2,677 PASS. FAIL: at 1920x800, RIGHT column body STILL needs internal scroll and Confirm/Cancel still clip below viewport (regression from v2.13 unresolved).

ui_bugs.component: Check-In v2.14 right column body + pinned footer
ui_bugs.issue: Requirement 'RIGHT has NO internal scroll and Confirm visible at 1920x800' still FAILS. Measured on ?checkin=a2 at 1920x800: right body scrollH=421 vs clientH=350 (overflow-y:auto, so internal scroll IS needed); outer .panel scrollH=1088 vs clientH=638 (outer scroll still required); checkin-confirm-button rect y=798..834 and checkin-cancel-button y=798..832 with viewportH=800 → both partially clip below the viewport. Same root cause as iteration_5: pane max-height fallback ~514px + surrounding page chrome pushes pane bottom past 800px.

action_items: Fix the persistent 1920x800 issue: RIGHT ci-pane-body currently overflows (scrollH 421 vs clientH 350) and Confirm/Cancel clip at y=798..834 vs viewport=800. Options: (a) actually populate --ci-height in fitCheckin() so ci-pane max-height tracks window.innerHeight minus outer chrome (currently CSS var is empty and 514px fallback is not viewport-aware), (b) shrink right column body content so scroll is not needed (task states 'no internal scroll'), (c) make the outer .panel not itself scroll (currently scrollH=1088, clientH=638) so the fixed footer stays within viewport.

Optional: verify Room upgrade card testid nomenclature — task expected 'checkin-upgrade-option-*' but implementation reuses 'checkin-room-option-*' for upgrade rooms shown after clicking checkin-upgrade-toggle. Functionally identical (upgrade note + checkin-upgrade-paid appear after picking a higher-category room), but naming diverges from the review spec — decide whether to add distinct testids or update the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: fitCheckin() still does not set the --ci-height CSS var so ci-pane falls back to a fixed 514px max-height, causing the same overflow issue reported in v2.13 iteration_5. Compute --ci-height = window.innerHeight - offsetTop - padding on resize/load.
Consider making .ci-pane-foot position:sticky bottom:0 inside .panel so Confirm/Cancel remain in view even when the outer container needs to scroll.

success_rate.frontend: 10 of 11 spec items PASS; RIGHT-no-scroll-and-Confirm-visible at 1920x800 still FAIL

context_for_next_testing_agent: Only remaining defect on v2.14 is the layout/height issue at 1920x800 (RIGHT internal scroll + Confirm clipped). Everything else (structure, live-updating upgrades, collapsible auto-collapse, lightbox, pills white, Card→Txn/UTR, confirm toast, prepaid a5, late a1, mobile stack, checkout 103/107) verified PASS with no console errors.
rca of the issue: At viewport 1920x800: outer .panel scrollHeight=1088 > clientHeight=638 → outer scroll required. Inside, .ci-pane uses a CSS fallback max-height ~514px because fitCheckin() does not actually write --ci-height to :root/scope (var is empty). Combined with page header/chrome above, ci-pane bottom lands at y≈834 with checkin-confirm-button at y=798..834 and checkin-cancel-button at y=798..832 (viewport height=800). Additionally .ci-pane-body has overflow-y:auto with content 421px in a 350px client, adding an internal scrollbar to the RIGHT column. Fix vectors: (1) implement fitCheckin() to compute --ci-height dynamically; (2) reduce RIGHT body content so scrollH ≤ clientH at 1920x800; (3) make .ci-pane-foot sticky within .panel so Confirm stays visible.
